ownership: Classical and parent-owned distinction games, deterministic continuation semantics, shortest paths, finite refinement and ultrametric constructions. V10 adapts them to an explicit scalar operational resource and observation contract. No novelty or priority claim.

sources.title: Process Equivalence Problems as Energy Games
sources.read_scope: Primary full text: definitions6-9 and propositions2-3, PDFpp8-9; distinction soundness/completeness and theorem1, pp12-13; algorithm1 and section4.3, pp15-17.
sources.parent_result: Minimal winning initial energies characterize distinguishing logical observations; attacker-winning energies are upward closed, with witness extraction and equivalence spectra.
sources.adaptation: V10 replaces six expressiveness dimensions and a two-player spectroscopy game by deterministic paired executions with one consumed operational resource.
sources.limits: The paper's logical prices are not operational machine costs. V10's cost-observability iff and local mismatch thresholds are proved directly, not asserted to be its theorem verbatim.

sources.title: Elements of generalized ultrametric domain theory
sources.read_scope: Primary PDF section2, printedpp350-351/PDFpp2-3, definitions of generalized/pseudo ultrametrics and Example2.1(6).
sources.parent_result: Transition-system simulation approximants induce a generalized ultrametric inf{2^(-n):s approximates_n t}.
sources.adaptation: V10 uses symmetric response equivalences indexed by operational resource and the first-distinction convention 2^(-D), then separates zero-distance classes.
sources.limits: Approximation-depth and first-distinction indexing are not identical conventions. No novelty for the exponential metric construction; the chosen base is a scale. This symmetric D is not a directed transformation cost.

sources.title: Reasoning About Bounds in Weighted Transition Systems
sources.read_scope: Primary PDF model definition2.1,p4; weighted and generalized weighted bisimulation definitions2.6-2.7,p5.
sources.parent_result: Exact-weight matching differs from coarser matching of lower and upper weight bounds to equivalence classes.
sources.adaptation: Explicitly retain exact observed edge costs for baseline resource equivalence, and isolate hidden-cost event maps as a separate theorem/control.
sources.limits: Bounds-only equivalence cannot silently substitute for exact event/cost matching; the paper does not directly supply V10's initial-resource threshold.

sources.title: A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs
sources.read_scope: Original primary scan, Problem2 and remarks1-2, printedpp270-271/PDFpp2-3.
sources.parent_result: Shortest-path settlement by increasing tentative distance and predecessor records, including direction-dependent edge lengths.
sources.adaptation: Reverse shortest paths from mismatch on the finite unordered-pair graph, with infinity for unreachable vertices and settlement-rank witness links.
sources.limits: Product-graph correctness is proved separately. Zero-cost witness progress and unreachable cases are explicit implementation obligations, not inferred from Bellman equality alone.

sources.title: Optimal Reachability in Divergent Weighted Timed Games
sources.read_scope: Primary PDF section2,pp3-4, finite weighted games, accumulated weight and first-target reachability value.
sources.parent_result: Reachability payoff sums costs until first target and assigns positive infinity when the target is never reached.
sources.adaptation: After reduction, V10 is a one-player nonnegative finite minimum-cost reachability instance.
sources.limits: No timed-game, negative-weight or adversarial-game result is imported into V10. Zero cycles are permitted here without invoking that paper's divergence restriction.

sources.title: Morphisms and Minimisation of Weighted Automata
sources.parent_result: A weighted automaton has a unique coarsest congruence/minimal quotient, which need not be the globally smallest realization of its recognized series.
sources.adaptation: Restrict storage minimality to codes sufficient for the declared response family at externally known fixed resource.
sources.limits: No identification with unrestricted weighted realization minimization or total online-memory optimization.

local_parents.use: Complete deterministic responses, quotient sufficiency, residual-resource lifting, and word-length refinement bound n-k; V10 derives a resource threshold from these semantics.
Prior disclosed graph-threshold candidate, hidden-cost control, zero-cycle Bellman gap and distinction between snapshot codes and online memory. These are not newly discovered after the V10 freeze.
Recoverability is relative to declared observations and attained-image decoders. T3's cost recovery is likewise conditioned on the known action.

proof_trust: THEORY_V10.md contains direct general paper proofs. ResourceV10.lean and its separate scope record identify kernel-checked statements; Python is independently tested, not claimed extracted or kernel verified.
claim_boundary: Finite deterministic supplied machines, natural consumption, exact retained events and explicit observation maps. No empirical accuracy, stochastic or divergent semantics, universal intelligence, all-family derivation or new literature priority.
